kaikki_vikisozluk.t: From a Canaanite language, doublet of حُمَّاض (ḥummāḍ), but perhaps transmitted through Aramaic considering its presence inland in Arabia; compare Classical Syriac ܚܲܡܘܼܨܬܵܐ (ḥammūṣtā, “rhubarb”). Unclear relationship to South Levantine Arabic حَمْصِيص (ḥamṣīṣ, “cape sorrel; Oxalis pes-caprae”).
s: South Levantine Arabic حَمْصِيص (ḥamṣīṣ, “cape sorrel; Oxalis pes-caprae”)
g: any member of the species Rumex pictus of docks or sorrels
